sources.entry: Mac Classic Player - Keyboard-driven media player for macOS, in the spirit of Media Player Classic.

summary.one_liner: A keyboard-driven, MPC-inspired video and audio player for macOS built with Tauri and React.
summary.what_it_does: Mac Classic Player is a minimal media player for macOS that plays .mov, .mp4, .webm, and audio files such as .mp3, .m4a, and .wav. It offers full keyboard control covering seek, volume, fullscreen, playlist, and help. Files can be loaded by drag and drop, by clicking to open, or with the O shortcut. Play/pause, stop, and a percentage seek (keys 0 to 9 jump to 0% to 90%) are included. It remembers volume and window size between sessions, and has a playlist with looping, a shortcut help overlay toggled with ?, and a track info overlay toggled with i. The README says .hevc support is planned.
use_cases: play local video files on a Mac
play audio files like mp3 or wav
replace QuickTime-style playback with an MPC-like interface
loop a playlist of local media
notable: Keyboard-first design with shortcuts for seek, volume, fullscreen, playlist, help, and track info
Percentage seek with number keys 0 to 9
Remembers volume and window size between launches
Inspired by Media Player Classic's interface
caveats: Requires a Rust toolchain alongside Node to build the Tauri native side
HEVC (.hevc) support is only planned, not yet available
The README does not name supported macOS versions or a pre-built download location beyond a 'Download the latest version' link
